school_gates.name: School Gates
school_gates.description: Wrought-iron gates at dusk. A brass automaton checks each new student in turn before the gates swing open onto the entrance plaza.

entrance_plaza.name: Entrance Plaza
entrance_plaza.description: A wide flagstoned plaza just inside the gates. The Headmaster's tower rises to one side and the faculty offices line the other; a broad avenue runs deeper in toward the main plaza.

headmasters_tower.name: Headmaster's Tower
headmasters_tower.description: A slender spire of dark stone at the edge of the entrance plaza. The Headmistress receives new students at its foot.

faculty_offices.name: Faculty Offices
faculty_offices.description: A low range of buildings off the entrance plaza, its quiet corridors lined with the offices of the teaching staff.

main_plaza.name: Main Plaza
main_plaza.description: The heart of the academy. The Dueling Palace and the main academic building face each other across the square, and paved roads branch off to the left and right plazas.

dueling_palace.name: Dueling Palace
dueling_palace.description: A sand-floored arena warded for magical combat, its galleries hung with duelling trophies.

main_academic_building.name: Main Academic Building
main_academic_building.description: Rows of desks beneath a vaulted, rune-carved ceiling. The academy's core lectures are held here.

left_plaza.name: Left Plaza
left_plaza.description: A quieter square reached by a small paved road, fronting the secondary academic building.

secondary_academic_building.name: Secondary Academic Building
secondary_academic_building.description: An annexe of smaller halls and workshops off the left plaza, where the practical courses meet.

right_plaza.name: Right Plaza
right_plaza.description: The dormitories' plaza. The residence halls stand along one side, and a garden road leads off beneath a stone arch.

dormitories.name: Dormitories
dormitories.description: Your small dormitory room off the right plaza: a bed, a desk, and a wardrobe.

gardens.name: Gardens
gardens.description: Terraced gardens beyond the dormitories' plaza, quiet and green under the dusk.
